# Grok Bot Architecture

Independent, MIT-licensed reference for Grok Bot-style AI agent teams: nine role skills, multi-agent orchestration, MCP connectors, typed handoffs, and human-in-the-loop approval. Not affiliated with xAI or Cursor; not the Grok Bot product source or an official integration. Host, model, and framework independent. JSON validation does not authenticate approvals; the local runtime example delegates identity and authorization to host callbacks and is not production-ready.

Prove the contracts:

```text
node scripts/validate-all.mjs
```
